subject: MedSX: Region lock & SIG/CAIQ evidence request
messages:
From: Anders Holm <anders.holm@medsx.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.in
Date: 2025-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 evidence for EU-only hosting and PrivateLink

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As next steps the security team asked for a compact evidence bundle so our reviewers can sign off on region isolation for our PoC.

Specifically we need:
- Completed SIG/CAIQ and CAIQ checklist answers with any applicable attachments
- SOC 2 summary report (SOC 2 Type II preferred) or an attestation letter
- Network diagram showing EU-only PrivateLink/VPC peering (ingress/egress paths)
- Confirmation of KMS partitioning and whether key material is tenant-isolated or region-scoped
- Typical retention windows for logs and KV caches related to inference requests

Target: do you think you can share a package by EOD Monday (June 1)? If not, a short timeline helps us coordinate the internal review.

Also copy security@medsx.com on the reply.

Appreciate it,
Anders Holm
Head of Security, MedSX
anders.holm@medsx.com
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.in
To: Anders Holm <anders.holm@medsx.com>
Cc: security@medsx.com, irene.choi@redwood.in, rishi.malhotra@redwood.in, logan.wright@redwood.in
Date: 2025-05-28T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 evidence for EU-only hosting and PrivateLink

Anders —

Thanks, we can pull this together. Short plan below and owners:
- SIG/CAIQ answers + CAIQ checklist: Irene Choi (compliance)
- SOC 2 summary and attestation references: Rishi Malhotra (security)
- Network diagram & peering notes: Logan Wright (infra)
- KMS/key partitioning + retention: combined note (Rishi + Logan)

We can provide a compact packet by Monday EOD. If the reviewers want a deep-dive, we can schedule a 30-min walkthrough the next day.

I'll attach the packet once we have everything consolidated.

— Lauren Bishop
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.in
From: irene.choi@redwood.in
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.in, rishi.malhotra@redwood.in, logan.wright@redwood.in
Date: 2025-05-30T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 evidence for EU-only hosting and PrivateLink

Team,

Drafting updates:
- Attached: sig_caiq_answers_med_sx_20250601.xlsx (answers filled, marked RED for items needing infra input)
- Attached: network_diagram_eu_privatelink.png (annotated with peering endpoints; needs Logan verification)

Rishi — can you confirm KMS partitioning statement? Current draft says:
"Customer keys are stored under a tenant-scoped KMS instance; key material is region-scoped and never exported outside the EU. Operator-managed platform keys are held separately and are not used to decrypt customer data."
If we can add a short note on HSM usage and rotation cadence that would be great.

Logan — please validate the diagram and explicitly call out NAT/Bastion egress paths if any. MedSX asked specifically about egress controls to third-party telemetry.

I will assemble the SOC 2 summary (public summary + pointer to auditor attestation) once I have Rishi and Logan's confirmations. Targeting package for Monday morning.

Irene Choi
Sr. Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Anders Holm <anders.holm@medsx.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.in
Cc: security@medsx.com
Date: 2025-06-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG/CAIQ + SOC2 evidence for EU-only hosting and PrivateLink

Lauren / Team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. We received the packet and the attachments. A couple of quick clarifications from our reviewers before we close the PoC checklist:

1) KMS: can you confirm whether HSM-backed keys are used for tenant keys and whether crypto operations are performed in an EU zone (we need a one-sentence assurance we can reference in our audit)
2) Egress: the network diagram looked good — please confirm whether telemetry to Sentry/Datadog ever leaves EU borders or is proxied through EU collectors
3) Timeline: if we need any follow-up artefacts, what’s the fastest you can supply them (internal ask for 48 hours)

If you can reply with those three points, we can mark the region-isolation check complete and proceed with contract signatures.

Best,
Anders
Head of Security, MedSX
